speaker: A
name: Alex
text: "Old people" is a general concept — age only.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Even people of the same age have different learning abilities and different learning skills.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Some of them can absolutely use technology well.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: But if a person never built the habit of learning new things — for example, my grandparents, they'd say, "Oh, I'm old, I don't want to learn new things, I can't learn new things" — then they just make excuses and can't use technology well.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: So I think it depends on the person's personality.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: Someone like me — when I'm old, I'll still be following the latest technology trends, because I like learning new things.

speaker: A
name: Alex
text: The future of technology will be brilliant, and I'll definitely be into it and use it well — maybe even better than my own children.
